name: Full Release!
summary: Quality of life, text to speech, and finally: fully released.
highlights: Text to Speech {Fish Audio supported only for now.}
Fixed isssues with corrupted LLM outputs

new_features.title: Text to Speech
new_features.description: Every AI message now has a text to speech button. You can press the TTS button, after setting up your provider in the api settings/setting a voice ID for the character, and have it be read out by the voice.

improvements.title: Corrupted LLM Outputs
improvements.description: Some LLMs, especially Deepseek models tend to output garbled, corrupted text, known as mojibake. It should happen way less now.

improvements.title: Optimizations
improvements.description: There's been some read-write optimizations, no functional difference, just easier on lighter hardware, less full re-reads of chat history, etc.
